title: Idle registration and push foot contact
scope: toe-target response while the deck carves

retail_evidence.claim: PushStart uses a 0.3 second transition; contact/cycle are sequence leaves; PushEnd uses 0.2 seconds.
Compact channels 32 and 33 are the board-parented right/left toe target animations.
Runtime target mapping, target-specific RIG_TPOSE composition, and prior in-game foot-target verification.
Board-space in-place conversion preserves toe-target vectors while removing shared horizontal travel.

runtime_observation_gate.source: The in-game ONBOARD IK diagnostic after final transform propagation.

human_checks: At neutral idle, the rider's stance is centered longitudinally over the retail deck.
During a regular push, the support foot follows the carving deck without sliding; the pushing foot follows the extracted push animation.
During a mongo push, the opposite support foot follows the carving deck without sliding.
Returning from either push does not pop, snap, or shift the rider relative to the board.
known_out_of_scope_unknowns: The exact runtime ApplyingBodyTilt clamp attributes have not yet been captured.
Push transitionUnder and sequence timing are not accepted by this checkpoint.
The Bevy analytic leg solve still requires a final-matrix comparison against retail SkeletonIK::BlendTransforms.
